Compute the standard isentropic (Saint-Venant) flow relations for a perfect gas with gamma = 1.4 at Mach number M = 0.5.
Report the following stagnation-to-static ratios as numerical values: T0/T, P0/P, and rho0/rho.
Use the exact isentropic formulas: T0/T = 1 + (gamma - 1)/2 * M^2; P0/P = (T0/T)^(gamma/(gamma - 1)); rho0/rho = (T0/T)^(1/(gamma - 1)).
No specific static pressure, temperature, or density value is required; all results are dimensionless ratios.
Present each ratio to at least four significant figures.
